title: Sausage and Vegetable Stir-Fry (Ssoya)
summary: A quick Korean side dish of Vienna sausages and crisp vegetables coated in a sweet, mildly spicy ketchup-gochujang sauce.

steps.description: Make 2 or 3 shallow diagonal cuts on each Vienna sausage. Cut the onion and red, yellow, and green bell peppers into bite-size pieces.
Mix the ketchup, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, and water in a small bowl to make the sauce.
Heat the cooking oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry for 20 to 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the Vienna sausages and stir-fry for about 2 minutes until lightly browned.
Add the onion and cook for 1 minute. Add the red, yellow, and green bell peppers and stir-fry for another 1 to 2 minutes, keeping them slightly crisp.
Pour in the sauce and stir-fry over medium-low heat for 1 to 2 minutes until everything is evenly coated and the sauce thickens slightly.
Turn off the heat and sprinkle with the toasted sesame seeds to finish.
